Good day, drivers!

We’re proud to present the biggest update in Trail Out’s history. Version 5.0 brings major improvements across nearly every map, adds fresh gameplay features, and completely reworks the story-driven career mode.

Thanks for your long wait — after 10 months of hard work, sweat, and stress, we’re finally releasing this update. We hope you enjoy it. We strongly recommend starting a new game to experience everything we’ve added from the ground up.
Here’s a breakdown of the changes — there’s so much, it’s easier to list what we didn’t touch! Some things might’ve even slipped past our changelog.

items.text: Hi everyone! We are still working hard on the latest major update.

You may have also noticed that there are new Achievements in Steam, but they can only be unlocked in the new update, we apologize for the inconvenience. (Also the bug with the career trick on Xbox will be fixed in the next update).

Also I want to remind you that we are recycling the career and it will make more sense to replay the game again.

releases.displayName: New update soon and release on Xbox X/S!

items.text: Hello, drivers!
The game is now available on the Xbox Series X/S and the release was good enough and we want to let you know that a major update and Trail Out version 3.0 is coming soon!

From the main new features it will be available NEW GAME +, for those who want to go through the game again, but under different conditions. You are given initially several cars and a new health system for drivers. Each driver has its own health in real-time, you need to heal and control more your money management. This is something we had planned before the release, but only got to finish today.

Also will be available improved Hunter mode, with the ability to choose a car and call for reinforcements, like Killstrike system from the Call Of Duty series. Also changed the conditions of the mode and added some mode lore.

As well as a major new fall map located in the mountains of Canada - Golden Trail. Jumping, racing, dynamic day and night system, and the novelty of dynamic weather change! This system is supported by several other major maps as well.
In addition to this update contains many other innovations, such as new cars, changes in gameplay and so on. We will tell you more about it later and the release is very soon!

It is also possible that due to changes in Valve's terms and conditions there will be a revision of regional prices in Steam and currency changes in some countries. If you or your friends were planning to buy the game - we notify you in advance.
Happy anniversary of the release of Trail Out! ːMihalychː

Thank you for being with us this year. We have supported the game for exactly one year and today we are releasing the latest update of the game with 2 new cross maps "Älgskogen" and "Triumph", the biggest derby map Construction, a new car "Bullet GG" and a skin for Mihalych "Driver"! ːMihalychRageː c

Unfortunately, due to development difficulties and lack of resources, we are freezing multiplayer development until an indefinite time frame. We'll await the results of the update and focus on porting Trail Out to Playstation 5 and XBox Series S/X consoles. The system requirements for PC have been updated.

With that said, we've prepared the first DLC in the form of cars! Thank you for your attention and support! Have a great time with the new physics and racing under the scorching sun of Madagascar! ːMihalychː
Please leave a review on Steam page if you liked the game! It will help us a lot.
Find 3 secret character appearances on the roads of Madagascar!
Hello drivers! It's been a long time. We're not missing, we're working hard. ːMihalychː
Over the past few months we are working on two major updates - Wild Roads and a complete physics overhaul of the game - Trail Out v2.0.
Wild Roads adds sun, beach and jungle to the game with new cars, and new physics will bring the feeling of real cars to the game. And that's not all.
Release in June, keep in touch! ːThanCatː

items.text: A major update: Dead Out: Salvation!

We've redesigned the zombie mode and brought it back to the game permanently, as requested! Dead Out mode can be found in Fest App inside the game and rewards for completing the mode come in the form of a Bat Car and more!

Clean up a contaminated Los Angeles after Frank Woods' chemical attack! You'll have to take down mutated Trail Out Festival bosses and clear your way among the crowds of zombies and other dangerous foes.
You have access to armed vehicles ranging from machine guns to salvos and a playable driver with cold and firearms!
We also have the new derby map, Museum! Crush some of the most expensive exhibits in the world and take first place.

notes.title: We are releasing a small update with changes

items.text: The weight of the machines became more and the damage began to be felt more strongly.
A new darts trick has become available in the demo, score the most points.
Enabled physics smoothing depending on FPS, should help players with weak hardware
The duration of the demo has been increased to two hours.
The camera has become a little faster, higher and less shaking.

The stabilization of the car has become better, but more accurate when cornering at high speed, we will rework the settings of the car after the demo.: We are waiting for your new feedback and hope for your understanding that this is the first public beta within the framework of the demo festival, everything can change for the better by the release of the game.: Good luck on the road!
